`dom-fortnite.json` is the source model that exposed the import rounding/glow bug.

`dom-fortnite.svg` is an independent reference built from the shipped Crosshair Y
`getCrispLineProps` and `getCrispOutlineRects` geometry, retaining per-arm outline
filters and the layer transform. It is intentionally not generated by CrosshairCore.
Reference bundle: `index-DFTIAhV3.js`, SHA-256
`860bc1954e77c0ce77873921f42b32b22a851d6620bf338b3366d853f6c9971b`.

SVG viewport/filter rasterization may differ by up to 3/255 in premultiplied channels.
Preview/export comparisons additionally require exact pixel equality between canvas modes.
